sec: sec:A004: Protect IP & trade secrets / Control mays

blocks.id: blk:A004: Protect IP & trade secrets / Control mays/1
blocks.text: Leveraging foundation model provider protections. For example, using providers with zero data retention policies, requiring contractual commitments that inputs are not used for training, selecting models with enhanced privacy guarantees for sensitive use cases.

sentences.text: For example, using providers with zero data retention policies, requiring contractual commitments that inputs are not used for training, selecting models with enhanced privacy guarantees for sensitive use cases.

blocks.id: blk:A004: Protect IP & trade secrets / Control mays/2
blocks.text: Implementing technical controls to detect proprietary information in outputs.

sentences.text: Implementing technical controls to detect proprietary information in outputs.

blocks.id: blk:A004: Protect IP & trade secrets / Control mays/3
blocks.text: Establishing output monitoring for high-risk IP scenarios. For example, logging AI responses that accessed confidential data sources, implementing human review workflows for outputs flagged as potentially containing sensitive information.
